reproducedFailure.finding: Threshold-probability claims for BOTH receiving families are one-sidedly optimistic on held-out 2025: at every calibration bin above ~0.2, the observed over-rate is below the predicted probability (gaps to -0.27 for receptions in the 0.6-0.7 bin).
reproducedFailure.trainVisible: The same one-sided direction holds inside the fit period (2024 walk-forward diagnostic, --diagnose-season lane, measurement only): observed < predicted in every meaningful bin for both families. The bias is structural, not 2025 drift, so a train-fit correction is admissible.
reproducedFailure.mechanismHypothesis: Listed role-share receivers are allocated too large a slice of team targets — the unlisted OTHER share is underestimated — so simulated receptions and receiving yards sit right of reality for modeled players.

candidate.scope: ONE new fitted parameter: fit.dispersion.targetShareDeflation (gamma), applied multiplicatively to each modeled player's effective target share before allocation (the freed mass goes to OTHER by construction). Nothing else changes: volumes, shapes, kappas, rates, game-sim heads, and the pass/rush paths are untouched.
candidate.selection: gamma chosen from the frozen grid [1.00, 0.98, 0.96, 0.94, 0.92, 0.90] INSIDE the fit period: the value minimizing the SUM of the two receiving families' walk-forward threshold ECE on season-2024 scoring (the same inside-train selection style as the champion's rate-shrink m). Ties break toward 1.00 (least intervention).
candidate.whatIsNotAllowed: No selection on 2025; no per-player or per-bin corrections; no post-hoc probability relabelling that leaves the distribution unchanged; no touching pass or rush families.

protocol.fit: 2023-24 REG+POST only, identical to champion, plus the gamma grid selection above
protocol.test: held-out 2025 scored ONCE with the selected gamma, --runs 1000, identical scoring points

frozenBars.perFamily: Each family judged SEPARATELY; one may clear while the other does not.

player_reception_yds.maeBeats: rolling4 AND shareVol on identical points

decisionRule: A family clearing ALL its bars has its promotion recomputed by the evaluator's standard gates with the selected gamma; a family failing any bar stays exactly at its champion state. gamma == 1.00 selected in train means the candidate is vacuous and is recorded as REJECTED without touching 2025.
